headline: Revolut Announces $1 Billion Latin American Expansion Plan
summary: British fintech Revolut announced an initial $1.1 billion investment in Latin America, focusing expansion efforts on Brazil and Mexico alongside entries into Colombia, Peru, and Argentina.
why: Cross-border expansion by major venture-backed fintech firms can alter competitive dynamics in emerging digital banking markets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Revolut's regional expansion targets Brazil and Mexico as core markets.
